items.title: Scrap junk to produce Lead
items.detail: Craft Bulk Lead at a Tinker's Workbench, then scrap it for the fastest completion.

items.title: Collect a Microscope or Biometric Scanner
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has several Microscopes in various rooms.

items.title: Craft any Flair at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Flairs are cosmetic backpack trinkets unlocked from Season Scoreboards or Seasonal Events.

items.title: Kill a Blood Eagle
items.detail: Dagger's Den is a reliable spawn location with 15 Blood Eagles.

items.title: Kill a Honey Beast
items.detail: The Freak Show has reliable Honey Beast spawns; target the head for faster kills.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume outfit, hat, or mask before the kill. Found at cabins and fairgrounds.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture at the Super Duper Mart in the Burning Springs
items.detail: Equip the Camera from your Pip-Boy and take a picture at the location.

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Fast travel to your C.A.M.P. or claim a workshop, then place any small decoration or building piece.

items.title: Collect Ballistic Ammo
items.detail: Pull ammo from your stash, craft it at a Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies.

items.title: Craft Bulk Steel
items.detail: Craft at a Tinker's Workbench using Steel scrap and Plastic.

items.title: Craft Bulk Wood
items.detail: Craft at a Tinker's Workbench using Wood scraps and Plastic.

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Limb
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has dense Super Mutant spawns; use Enforcer perk or V.A.T.S. targeting.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Blackwater Mine is a reliable spawn location; target the head in V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Head Hunt
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town's Bounty Board, then kill with bladed melee weapons.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Black Titanium
items.detail: Scrap Mole Miner suit scraps or Loose excavator power armor mod boxes at any workbench.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Any NPC vendor works; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors.

items.title: Repeatable Under Rank 100: Gain XP
items.detail: Earn XP by playing normally; only appears if Scoreboard rank is below 100.

items.title: Repeatable at Rank 100 or above: Complete a Public Event
items.detail: Complete any public event; only appears at Scoreboard rank 100 or above.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double SCORE from challenges and double caps from vendors.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special anniversary-themed event with unique rewards.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Minerva offers discounted legendary crafting and armor plans.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Earn bonus caps and encounter mutated enemy variants in public events.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events feature mutated enemies with special rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Earn double experience from all activities.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Hunt holiday-themed Scorched creatures for festive rewards.
